datum: I will walk before the Lord * in the land of the living.
Woe is me! O Lord, * that my sojourn is long
The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, * the Lord shall keep thy soul.
If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, * O Lord, who shall stand.
O Lord, forsake not * the works of thine own hands.
V. I heard a voice from heaven, saying unto me:
R. Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord.
All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; * and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.
Unto the Eternal King all live. * O come, let us worship Him.
Make my way straight before thy face, O Lord my God.
Return, O Lord, deliver my soul * O save me for thy mercy's sake.
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, * while there is none to deliver, or to save.
V. From the gates of hell.
R. Deliver their souls, O Lord.
He maketh me to lie down * in green pastures.
Lord, remember not the sins of my youth, * nor my transgressions.
I believe that I shall yet see the goodness of the Lord * in the land of the living.
V. May the Lord set them with princes;
R. Even with the princes of his people.
Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me * O Lord, look upon me to help me.
Lord, heal my soul; * for I have sinned against thee.
My soul thirsteth for the living God; * when shall I come and appear before God?
V. O deliver not unto beasts the souls of them that praise thee!
R. And forget not the souls of thy poor for ever.
The bones which thou hast broken * may rejoice.
Lord, hear * my prayer; unto thee shall all flesh come.
Thy right hand * upholdeth me.
From the gates of hell * deliver my soul, O Lord.
Let everything that hath breath * praise the Lord.
I am the resurrection and the life: * he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live; and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die.
